availability.auctions: partial: quarterly auction tables July 2025–June 2026 plus 25 August and 3 September 2026 results; July–August 2026 coverage incomplete
availability.calendar: partial: pinned July–December 2026 quarterly plans plus selected later notices; not a complete live operations feed
availability.note: DMO report/issuance endpoints returned a CAPTCHA in the local source spike. Pinned official PDF notices are reproducible but do not discover new, changed or cancelled operations. Re-fetching these URLs does not constitute a fresh calendar check. Stock XML is a live feed.

definitions.stock: Gross gilts in issue, including government holdings, in GBP million of original nominal principal. Not market value and not public sector net debt.
definitions.maturity: Contractual maturity of original nominal principal. For index-linked gilts this is not the future cash redemption payment, which depends on RPI. No future inflation uplift is forecast.
definitions.uplifted: Nominal amount including DMO current inflation uplift, separately available; not a future redemption forecast.
definitions.coupon: Annual coupon percentage of nominal principal; not current market yield. Linker cash coupons also reflect indexation.
definitions.auctionAmounts: GBP million nominal, excluding post-auction option unless explicitly shown separately.
definitions.auctionYield: Conventional: yield at average accepted price. Index-linked: real striking yield. Do not compare these directly.
definitions.cover: Total bids divided by amount offered; DMO figure rounded to two decimals. Not bidder identities or investor allocations.
definitions.tail: Conventional yield at lowest accepted price less yield at average accepted price, in basis points using unrounded yields; not applicable to linker single-price auctions.
definitions.calendar: Quarterly dates are plans and later announcements can supersede them. Syndication date marked week commencing is not an exact sale date. Sizes are null until present in an announcement. The September 24 switch-auction pilot transfers no gilts and is excluded.
definitions.auctionPrecision: Quarterly review rows have issuance/PAOF rounded to £0.1m and yields rounded to 0.01 percentage points. Offered amount and total bids are unavailable in these tables; dash/blank PAOF retained as null. Individual notices retain published precision.
